GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well rails gate urged along led settled down just under a length Clear (1400m), held a similar margin in the run To The Turn niggled now though, joined Straight headed Soon After faded out of it (Winkers OFF AGAIN) # led/found little

Jumped well landing in front, briefly challenged held it (1400m), ran Clear Soon After led 4-5 Lengths 1000, Quickly coming back before Turn & all out cornering, rallied late to hold down third # led/went too hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned re tactics, Rdr explained intention to lead and put a margin on field, adding was asked to let gelding settle into a good tempo and not overly restrain. Tnr confirmed instructs, adding horse is suited when allowed to stride freely and was satisfied with the ride. Rdr was advised after obtaining lead in the early stages, should have made a better attempt to bring the horse back, in an endeavour to allow gelding the best opportunity to finish the race off.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly then & Went Forward to lead Two Wide by a head settling down, crossed to fence 900m, Held Together in front & led by 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed Straightening Up and Dropped Out in Straight # weak once headed

Began fairly. Niggled early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (5L from lead). Stayed Mid Field Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken @ 650m. Pushed along 3 Wide @ 500m & chasing Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Seven Wide @ 300m & gave ground in last 200m. # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1500m was steadied when tightened for room.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Ridden Along Settled Down Off Mid-Field 3 Wide with a trail 7 Lengths Under Pressure x 500m, last into Straight - # Never Likely
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and settled towards the rear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well & led as expected ran 2 Lengths Clear (1400m), margin 1 Lengths approaching Turn , Quickly challenged into the Straight & headed near 200, faded to 4th # led/had chance

Jumped well off a Wide gate charging across looking for the lead & got it going out 3 Lengths Clear (1400m), ran it hard, led a length into the Straight , still led 200, only collared 100 & rallied hard to just miss out (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Winkers AGAIN) # led/went hard/good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported gelding had been reluctant to respond to riding previously to take up a forward position, and for this reason pressured mount passing the 1400m to establish a lead but thereafter travelled an even tempo whilst well ahead of the remainder of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, slow into stride and Settled Down 3 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked out to centre of track Straightening Up and couldn't really come on in straight. (Blinkers FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie FIRST TIME, Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) # very few excuses
Jumped well settled down Outside Leader (800m), Under Pressure Turn leader kicked well Clear for home this left standing, faded Further latter stages # sat
Jumped ok Wide out pushing on landed within 2-3 Lengths couldn't get in though & facing breeze (900m), Under Pressure before Turn , faded all Straight # Wide no cover/tired
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.25 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide soon after, Drifted Back to 7 Lengths Two Wide turning, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened badly

(ex Trevor Rogers) Jumped well Wide out pushed on & led clearly (800m), kept on running To The Turn cornered for home going ok 2 Lengths Clear , whip 200 still Clear , held closers late (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) FIRST TIME, Winkers FIRST TIME) # led/too speedy!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.
